title: Zuse: A Decision Model for European Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.06238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models read a document and return a probability for each of a fixed set of options instead of generating text. Several appeared in 2026, but none has published results outside English. We describe Zuse, three decision models (4B, 9B and 27B) that train a low-rank adapter and a pointer head on frozen open-weight bases, targeting 27 European languages, and use them to study how this design behaves across languages and tasks. On a broad European suite of 11 sources excluded from training, covering 9 task groups and 27 languages, a development set that also guided model selection, the 27B model reaches 87.5% accuracy with a pooled expected calibration error of 0.016, and 0.035 when weighted per source. Post-hoc analyses of these single-seed results give three findings. translated_title: Zuse：面向欧洲语言的决策模型
translated_abstract: 决策模型读取文档并为固定选项集合中的每个选项返回概率，而非生成文本。2026年出现了若干此类模型，但没有一个发表过英语以外的结果。我们提出Zuse——三个决策模型（4B、9B和27B），它们在冻结的开源权重基座上训练低秩适配器和指针头，面向27种欧洲语言，并用它们研究这种设计在不同语言和任务上的表现。在一个由11个未参与训练的数据源组成的广泛欧洲评测套件上（涵盖9个任务组和27种语言，其中开发集也用于指导模型选择），27B模型达到87.5%的准确率，总体期望校准误差为0.016，按数据源加权时为0.035。对这些单种子结果的事后分析得出三点发现。其一，校准偏差是按任务而非按语言结构化的：在26种语言的平行阅读和主题类题目上，置信度差距的变化幅度大约与采样……（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: Zuse是首批面向27种欧洲语言的决策模型系列（4B/9B/27B），通过在冻结的开源基座上训练低秩适配器和指针头，实现了87.5%的准确率和极低的校准误差，并发现校准偏差主要由任务而非语言决定。
en_tdlr: Zuse introduces the first family of decision models (4B/9B/27B) covering 27 European languages, training low-rank adapters and pointer heads on frozen open-weight bases to achieve 87.5% accuracy with excellent calibration, and finds that miscalibration is structured by task rather than language.
